checks: A TSP activate reaches the stock tool approval selector and Deny prevents the inert tool from executing.
A new identical approval has a different component ID; an old event cannot approve it, while its own Approve executes the inert tool once.
The actual fallback selector accepts its fully qualified list/item IDs and rejects a disabled option.
A TSP plan choice resolves the stock InteractiveMode plan handler; Refine plan dismisses review, keeps plan mode, and makes no new provider call.
The native plan matches the known source sections; it omits the source title from the body, so the displayed projection is not an exact plan file export.
The stock rich editor advertises sendable:false and ignores atomic send; it must remain unsupported by this first remote request slice.
The stock simple input also advertises sendable:false and ignores atomic send; it remains unsupported.
limitations: Protocol terminal recorder, not a Tern binary or physical phone.
TSP activate has no expected-document revision; fresh host inspection is not an atomic cross-process compare-and-resolve.
Refine plan leaves feedback to the next explicit prompt; section annotation editing is separate.
Both extension rich editors and simple inputs lack atomic native send in this pinned OMP build.
